perspective: Returning learner with overdue reviews, previously completed material and newly observed difficulties.
method: Reproducible synthetic learner scenarios in owned standalone Chromium. These are software workflow simulations, not empirical learner research or measured retention outcomes.
status: Three reproduced findings resolved and verified on rebuilt app

findings.finding: A correction after reload was labelled independent recall despite the saved first failure.
reproduction: Open overdue review/say-hello from the two-minute review queue.
Submit a wrong first answer. The saved result is incorrect and the next review becomes tomorrow.
Reload, then enter the correction shown by the earlier feedback.
Before the fix, the UI displayed Recalled independently / Ricordato in autonomia while the saved first recall remained incorrect.
findings.learningRisk: The feedback could misrepresent remembering after viewing a correction as independent retrieval.
findings.resolution: ReviewView derives today's first outcome from saved review evidence. Supported correction, new scheduled independent success and extra practice receive distinct labels. Local attempt and scheduled state are keyed by date.
findings.verified: After reload the correction is labelled supported. The original wrong log, tomorrow schedule, one recorded attempt and original completion credit remain unchanged. A genuinely new scheduled correct answer receives independent feedback; repeating it after reload or practising early receives Extra practice.

findings.finding: A valid adjective-position alternative was recorded as a grammar error.
reproduction: Open grammar/a2-better-best?exercise=a2-better-best-4&review=1 with an overdue known exercise.
The prompt asks to use ottimo and retain Questa, without fixing adjective position.
Submit Questa è una soluzione ottima.
Before the fix, the answer was recorded as incorrect because only Questa è un’ottima soluzione. was accepted.
findings.learningRisk: A learner using the requested form correctly could receive false corrective feedback and a recorded failure.
findings.resolution: The existing answer list now accepts the natural post-noun variant as well as the original pre-noun form. The stable exercise ID and prompt remain unchanged. No derived diagnostic asks this transformation.
findings.verified: The post-noun variant receives correct, unassisted recall feedback in English and Italian. Regression tests retain rejection of ottimo/ottime agreement errors and preserve the original first attempt.

findings.finding: Diagnostic catch-up reopened old completed production instead of practice on the forgotten topic.
reproduction: Seed a2-conditional and its prerequisites as completed thirty days earlier, with saved writing and solved checks.
Follow the catch-up action labelled Practise this form.
Before the fix, grammar/a2-conditional opened Use it with the old writing and no exercise card.
findings.learningRisk: A learner seeking repair was sent back to a completed output rather than an opportunity to retrieve the form again.
findings.resolution: The parent integration added an explicit ?practice=1 catch-up intent. It opens Practise with blank Due recall when questions are due, otherwise All exercises. Ordinary lesson reopening retains its existing stage and writing.
findings.verified: Both diagnostic and weekly catch-up actions open the explicit practice route. Due answers begin blank, existing answers/attempts/output remain unchanged, normal reopening still resumes Use it, and a no-due request opens All exercises.

focusedTests.coverage: Saved first-failure correction after reload; scheduled versus extra practice feedback with date boundaries; both adjective positions and invalid agreement.

verification.parentIntegratedChecks: Parent reported all 230 daily tests, typecheck and lint passed before browser verification.

browser.visualReview: Viewed the corrected English phone recall feedback, accepted Italian phone adjective variant, and desktop blank due-practice destination.
stateAssertions: First recall failure, original completion credit, review log and tomorrow schedule survive correction and reload.
A new scheduled independent success is recorded once; extra practice does not add records or move due dates.
The accepted adjective alternative retains the original grammar attempt and records correct unassisted recall.
Diagnostic and weekly catch-up preserve existing production, answers and attempts while opening practice.
Normal lesson reopening preserves Use it; no-due catch-up opens All exercises.

boundaries: Fresh disposable contexts and synthetic localStorage only; no shared CDP, existing browser profile or real learner records were accessed.
Initial app inspection was read-only. Scoped fixes followed explicit parent authorization; the third fix was owned by the parent integration.
No deployment, credential access or change to the established scheduling intervals was performed by this audit.
The audit verifies the stated software paths and evidence labels; it does not establish learning effectiveness or claim an optimal spacing interval.
